description: Grants a role to an identity (a person, a group, a service account, an app) on a scope, until a date; only what one holds oneself, never to oneself. Access for an address in the company's domain: it waits for their first sign-in.

reason.description: Why ("Q4 audit"): it goes to the log and is read in the sentence.

role.description: A built-in role (owner, admin, developer, reader, access, data-reader, connection-caller, connection-writer, service-caller, data-writer) or one of the organization's (review_access { view: "roles" }).

scope.description: {}: the organization; otherwise down to a table, or a connection.

who.description: An address, group:<name>, service_account:<name>, app:<project>/<service> or task:<project>/<task>.
